pristine.sourcePolicy: repo-authored React Shape.Pie probes against @visx/visx with plain tsc

adapted.sourcePolicy: structurally equivalent Octane PieProps probes after permitted transformations

permittedTransformations.rule: Pristine imports Shape from @visx/visx and derives PieProps; adapted imports PieProps from @octanejs/visx shape source
Pristine rejects unknown Octane renderables with @ts-expect-error; adapted accepts the same call shapes without @ts-expect-error
Matching assertion groups must remain paired; deleting an assertion or removing a pristine @ts-expect-error fails inventory verification
